title: IGRINS the Immersion GRating INfrared Spectrometer
what_was_studied: Cryogenic immersion-grating design and simultaneous H and K coverage
numerical_result: IGRINS provides resolving power near 45000 over 1.49 to 1.80 and 1.96 to 2.46 micrometres
remaining_question: General high-resolution performance does not establish Doppler stability

title: IGRINS RV precision forward modelling in the near infrared
what_was_studied: Telluric-template calibration, instrumental-resolution modelling and stellar RV recovery
numerical_result: Reported standard-star precision was 31.1 m/s in H and 26.8 m/s in K
remaining_question: Telluric variability and target rotation still bound transfer to other samples

title: IGRINS RV a Python package for near-infrared radial velocities
numerical_result: The package documents roughly 25 to 30 m/s precision for narrow-line stars
remaining_question: Version-specific order corrections and input reduction choices need preservation

title: IGRINS RV workflow and convergence requirements
what_was_studied: Initial guesses, telluric modelling, convergence and uncertainty workflow
numerical_result: Initial RV and projected-rotation guesses should be known to about 5 km/s; additional runs can change uncertainty by up to 9 m/s
remaining_question: Sensitivity to priors and sparse visits should be tested automatically

title: Gemini integration-time calculator instrument roster
what_was_studied: Available instrument calculators and deployment labels
numerical_result: The current roster labels IGRINS-2 rather than the original travelling IGRINS configuration
remaining_question: The census must distinguish IGRINS from IGRINS-2 before claiming current Gemini operation
